verdict.rationale: Docs directly cover the core of the story: creating event types with configurable durations (docs-4), custom booking-form questions (docs-40), location/conferencing options (docs-7, docs-21), and confirmation/routing rules including round-robin and requiring-confirmation logic and routing forms (docs-25, docs-28, docs-8).
